question: As per the Economic Survey 2025-26, what were the Gross GST collections during the period of April–December 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹17.4 lakh crore.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Minister for Finance and Corporate Affairs Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman tabled the Economic Survey 2025-26 in Parliament.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Economic Survey 2025-26, the **Gross GST collections** during the period of **April–December 2025** stood at **₹17.4 lakh crore**.
 
• This registered a year-on-year growth of **6.7 per cent**.
 
• The survey noted that GST revenue growth is broadly aligned with prevailing nominal GDP growth conditions.
 
• Additionally, cumulative e-way bill volumes during the same period grew by 21 per cent YoY, indicating robust transaction volumes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Fiscal Developments (2025-26 Survey)__

 
 
• **Income Tax Returns:** Increased from 6.9 crore in FY22 to **9.2 crore** in FY25.
 
• **Centre's Revenue Receipts:** Strengthened to **9.2% of GDP** in FY25 (PA).
 
• **Credit Ratings:** Three sovereign credit rating upgrades in 2025 by Morningstar DBRS, S&P Global Ratings, and R&I, Inc.
